track_a_adb_drb.regime: Track A / Regime A1 (8q Compact ADB)
track_a_adb_drb.description: NISQ-scale 8-qubit circuit (7 state + 1 objective) over 100 capped term states; transpiled via Qiskit to {cx, rz, sx, x}.
track_a_adb_drb.qrom_or_oracle_note: Exact UCRYGate payoff loading on 7 state qubits (zero QRAM required).
track_a_adb_drb.nisq_feasibility: Fits on IonQ Forte (36q) & IQM Emerald (54q) for k <= 1 with ZNE; deep k requires FTQC.
track_a_adb_drb.ftqc_target_hardware: QuEra Libra (2028) — peak circuit ~0.35 Megaquops fits comfortably.

track_a_adb_drb.regime: Track A / Regime A2 (22q Non-Circular 3yr Path ADB)
track_a_adb_drb.description: Non-circular 3-year path IQAE built strictly from annual-states.csv (3 x 7q parallel annual registers + 1 objective + 14 adder ancillas).
track_a_adb_drb.classical_prep_complexity: O(S) = 100 annual states ONLY (zero classical 3-yr convolution!)
track_a_adb_drb.qrom_or_oracle_note: Reversible saturating 3-bit earthquake adders + 1-bit rain OR gates (no QRAM).
track_a_adb_drb.recommended_braket_simulator: SV1 / Local NVIDIA A100 GPU (22q = 64 MB complex128 statevector)
track_a_adb_drb.nisq_feasibility: 36 logical qubits matches IonQ Forte qubit count, but circuit depth requires FTQC.
track_a_adb_drb.ftqc_target_hardware: QuEra Libra (2028) — ~0.95 Megaquops at k=450 directly targets Libra era.

track_a_worldbank_elt.regime: Track A / Regime A2 (20q World Bank ELT, 2 countries)
track_a_worldbank_elt.description: Full-catalogue 421,968-event ELT (19 state + 1 objective + 19 QROM/comparator ancillas). Exploits verified uniform peril rates.
track_a_worldbank_elt.classical_prep_complexity: O(1) peril mixture weight (rates uniform per peril in audit.json!)
track_a_worldbank_elt.qrom_or_oracle_note: CRITICAL HONEST BOTTLENECK: Uniform-rate state prep costs only 122 CX (O(log N)), whereas unoptimized tabular QROM lookup over 421,968 rows costs ~2,531,808 CX. Replacing raw tabular lookup with our Track B Generative MPS / parametric loss model eliminates this QRAM bottleneck.
track_a_worldbank_elt.recommended_braket_simulator: SV1 / Local NVIDIA A100 GPU (20q = 16 MB complex128 statevector)
track_a_worldbank_elt.nisq_feasibility: Exceeds NISQ coherence depth due to 20q state space + payoff oracle.
track_a_worldbank_elt.ftqc_target_hardware: QuEra Libra (2028) for parametric/MPS-loaded oracle; raw QROM needs post-Libra FTQC.
